spawning._说明_中文: 全局自然生成准入与密度控制。
spawning._description_en: Global natural-spawn admission and density controls.
spawning._说明_enabled_中文: 自然生成总开关；结构固定生成、刷怪蛋和信号召唤不受此项控制。
spawning._description_enabled_en: Master natural-spawn switch; excludes structures, spawn eggs and signal summons.
spawning._说明_admission_chance_中文: 普通自然生成准入概率，0–1；乘各阶spawn_multiplier后最多为1，还需通过密度、日期、位置和冷却检查。
spawning._description_admission_chance_en: Ordinary admission probability, 0–1; multiplied by rank spawn_multiplier and capped at 1. Density, date, position and cooldown checks still apply.

progression._说明_中文: 个人在线日期与新手安全期。
progression._description_en: Personal online-day progression and safety period.
progression._说明_enabled_中文: 启用个人在线日期的出生解锁与安全日控制。 每位玩家跨维度独立累计在线游戏tick，24000 tick为一天；生成点使用同维度最近存活非旁观玩家的日期。离线、暂停、睡觉跳日、/time不推进。
progression._description_enabled_en: Enable personal online-day spawn unlock and safety rules. Each player accumulates online game ticks across dimensions, 24000 ticks per day. Spawns use the nearest living non-spectator player in their dimension. Offline time, pauses, sleep skips and /time do not advance it.
progression._说明_safe_days_中文: 完全禁止自然刷新的个人安全天数，0–1000000整数；与各阶解锁日同时生效。
progression._description_safe_days_en: Personal safety days with no natural spawning, integer 0–1000000; rank unlock days also apply.

first_spawn_day_by_tier._说明_中文: 各阶最早开始自然生成的模组日（1–1000000）。roamer=流浪者，tier1/tier2/tier3=一/二/三阶；独立配置，不要求按顺序递增。解锁只允许参与原有生成判定，不保证当天必定生成；自然大型战斗只能使用已解锁的一阶或二阶单位。
first_spawn_day_by_tier._description_en: First eligible mod day per tier (1–1000000). roamer, tier1, tier2 and tier3 are independently configurable; ascending order is not required. Unlocking permits existing spawn rules but does not guarantee a spawn. Automatic large battles use only unlocked tier I or tier II units.

spawning._说明_battle_admission_chance_中文: 自然战斗遭遇准入概率，0–1；不再乘各阶普通生成倍率。
spawning._description_battle_admission_chance_en: Natural battle admission probability, 0–1; does not multiply ordinary rank admission factors.
spawning._description_encounter_cooldown_ticks_en: Natural encounter cooldown in ticks; 20 ticks=1 second.
spawning._说明_nearby_horizontal_radius_中文: 局部密度检查的水平半径，格。
spawning._description_nearby_horizontal_radius_en: Horizontal radius of local density checks, in blocks.
spawning._说明_nearby_vertical_radius_中文: 局部密度检查的垂直半径，格。
spawning._description_nearby_vertical_radius_en: Vertical radius of local density checks, in blocks.
spawning._说明_density_divisor_中文: 局部人数容量的除数；越大容量越低。
spawning._description_density_divisor_en: Divisor used for local population capacity; larger values lower capacity.

ai._说明_enabled_中文: 增强战斗AI总开关；各阶具体AI参数独立设置，关闭不取消实体和雇佣关系。
ai._description_enabled_en: Enhanced combat AI master switch; detailed AI settings belong to rank files. Disabling does not remove entities or hires.
ai._说明_retreat_health_ratio_中文: 撤退生命比例，0.1–0.9；0.3表示剩余30%生命。
ai._description_retreat_health_ratio_en: Retreat health ratio, 0.1–0.9; 0.3 means 30% health remains.
ai._说明_critical_health_ratio_中文: 恢复动作使用的危急生命比例，0.05–0.75；实际不高于撤退阈值。战斗硬撤退底线由 low_health_combat 两个条件优先决定。
ai._description_critical_health_ratio_en: Critical recovery-action ratio, 0.05–0.75; capped at the retreat threshold. The two low_health_combat conditions take priority for forced combat retreat.
ai._说明_resume_health_ratio_中文: 恢复作战生命比例，0.2–1；至少比撤退阈值高0.05。
ai._description_resume_health_ratio_en: Resume-combat health ratio, 0.2–1; at least 0.05 above retreat.
ai._说明_low_health_combat_中文: 低血量搏斗策略，四阶文件分别设置。硬撤退须自身生命严格低于 critical_health_ratio × 最大生命且严格低于 critical_absolute_health 点；默认同时低于15%和25点。唯一有效对手同时低于其30%最大生命和30点时按 finish_chance 搏斗。试探按窗口内实际回血和实际受伤判断，不用尚未到账的预计恢复；食物仍走原进食动作，不免费回血。
ai._description_low_health_combat_en: Per-rank low-health combat. Forced retreat requires own health strictly below both critical_health_ratio times maximum health and critical_absolute_health points (default 15% and 25 points). A sole valid opponent below both 30% of its maximum health and 30 points enables finish_chance. Trials compare actual healing and damage within the observation window, not projected recovery. Food retains its normal use action and grants no free healing.

low_health_combat._说明_critical_health_ratio_中文: 硬撤退比例，0.01–0.30，并且不高于本阶 retreat_health_ratio；与绝对生命条件同时满足才硬撤退。
low_health_combat._description_critical_health_ratio_en: Forced-retreat ratio, 0.01–0.30, capped at this rank's retreat_health_ratio; the absolute-health condition must also hold.
low_health_combat._说明_critical_absolute_health_中文: 硬撤退绝对生命，1–1024点；自身生命严格低于本值并且低于比例阈值时才硬撤退。
low_health_combat._description_critical_absolute_health_en: Forced-retreat absolute health, 1–1024 points; own health must be strictly below this value and the ratio threshold.
low_health_combat._说明_finish_chance_中文: 唯一残血对手满足两个条件时尝试搏斗的概率，0–1；默认0.5。结果固定一段时间，避免每tick反复抽签。
low_health_combat._description_finish_chance_en: Chance to fight a sole opponent meeting both low-health conditions, 0–1; default 0.5. The result is held for a bounded period instead of rerolled every tick.
low_health_combat._说明_trial_ticks_中文: 恢复能力未知时的试探时长，20–200 tick；硬撤退底线随时优先。
low_health_combat._description_trial_ticks_en: Trial duration when recovery capacity is unknown, 20–200 ticks; forced-retreat thresholds always take priority.
low_health_combat._说明_observation_ticks_中文: 实际治疗与受伤观测窗口，20–400 tick；20 tick=1秒。
low_health_combat._description_observation_ticks_en: Window for actual healing and damage observations, 20–400 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
low_health_combat._说明_decision_hold_ticks_中文: 一次搏斗概率结果与恢复决策的最短保持时间，20–400 tick，避免反复逃跑和搏斗切换。
low_health_combat._description_decision_hold_ticks_en: Minimum hold for a fight roll and recovery decision, 20–400 ticks, to avoid alternating retreat and combat.
low_health_combat._说明_retry_delay_ticks_中文: 失败试探后再次尝试的等待时间，20–1200 tick。
low_health_combat._description_retry_delay_ticks_en: Delay before retrying a failed trial, 20–1200 ticks.
low_health_combat._说明_healing_safety_multiplier_中文: 判定恢复能覆盖伤害时所需的治疗安全倍率，1–3；默认实际治疗至少为伤害的1.1倍。
low_health_combat._description_healing_safety_multiplier_e: Healing margin needed to cover damage, 1–3; default actual healing must reach 1.1 times damage.

ai._说明_cover_search_attempts_中文: 掩体候选尝试数，2–24；过大增加寻路开销。
ai._description_cover_search_attempts_en: Cover candidate attempts, 2–24; larger values increase pathfinding work.
ai._说明_recovery_damage_tolerance_ratio_中文: 恢复过程中可容忍的受伤比例，0–1；按最大生命计算。
ai._description_recovery_damage_tolerance_r: Damage tolerance during recovery, 0–1 of maximum health.
ai._说明_recovery_commit_ticks_中文: 恢复动作承诺时间，0–40 tick；20 tick=1秒。
ai._description_recovery_commit_ticks_en: Recovery commitment time, 0–40 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
ai._说明_gradual_heal_interval_ticks_中文: 食物及再生额外回血间隔，2–40 tick；食物每次最多1点生命，再生I额外1点、再生II额外2点，可叠加。
ai._description_gradual_heal_interval_ticks: Food and bonus regeneration interval, 2–40 ticks. Food heals up to 1 HP per pulse; Regeneration I adds 1 HP and II adds 2 HP independently.
ai._说明_food_recovery_min_health_中文: 食物恢复生命量下限，0–20点；不是生命比例。
ai._description_food_recovery_min_health_en: Minimum food recovery health, 0–20 points; not a health ratio.
ai._说明_food_recovery_max_health_中文: 食物恢复生命量上限，1–30点；不是食物品质评分。
ai._description_food_recovery_max_health_en: Maximum food recovery health, 1–30 points; not food pickup value.
ai._说明_shield_block_duration_min_ticks_中文: 普通举盾时长下限，3–30 tick。
ai._说明_shield_block_duration_max_ticks_中文: 普通举盾时长上限，4–160 tick；至少比下限高1。
ai._description_shield_block_duration_max_t: Maximum normal shield duration, 4–160 ticks; at least one above the minimum.
ai._说明_shield_use_speed_multiplier_中文: 举盾移动倍率，0.1–1；移动举盾至少保留0.4。
ai._description_shield_use_speed_multiplier: Shield movement multiplier, 0.1–1; mobile blocks retain at least 0.4.
ai._说明_combat_jump_interval_min_中文: 普通远距离追击/逃跑的移动跳跃参数；不控制追击跳砍（全局jump_attack）。战斗跳跃间隔下限，4–40 tick。
ai._description_combat_jump_interval_min_en: Ordinary distant chase/retreat hops, separate from global jump_attack. Minimum combat jump interval, 4–40 ticks.
ai._说明_combat_jump_interval_max_中文: 普通远距离追击/逃跑的移动跳跃参数；不控制追击跳砍（全局jump_attack）。战斗跳跃间隔上限，5–60 tick；至少比下限高1。
ai._description_combat_jump_interval_max_en: Ordinary distant chase/retreat hops, separate from global jump_attack. Maximum combat jump interval, 5–60 ticks; at least one above minimum.
ai._说明_combat_jump_chance_中文: 普通远距离追击/逃跑的移动跳跃参数；不控制追击跳砍（全局jump_attack）。符合跳跃条件时的跳跃概率，0–1。
ai._description_combat_jump_chance_en: Ordinary distant chase/retreat hops, separate from global jump_attack. Jump chance when eligible, 0–1.
ai._说明_item_recovery_enabled_中文: 本阶物品恢复与初始补给开关；出生药水还受potions.enabled控制。
ai._description_item_recovery_enabled_en: Item recovery/initial supplies switch; spawn potions also require potions.enabled.
ai._说明_flee_hp_中文: 原生低血撤退生命比例，0–1；不是增强AI的retreat_health_ratio。
ai._description_flee_hp_en: Native low-health retreat ratio, 0–1; distinct from enhanced retreat_health_ratio.
ai._说明_run_away_middle_fight_chance_中文: 原生战斗中选择逃跑的概率，0–1。
ai._说明_mid_battle_buff_instead_of_run_chanc: 二阶人类在本轮战斗选择不撤退的额外概率，0–1；本项不直接提供强化或治疗。
ai._description_mid_battle_buff_instead_of_: Extra tier2 chance to forgo retreat for this combat, 0–1; does not itself grant a buff or healing.

recruitment._说明_中文: 全局玩家雇佣管理：各阶人数上限、支付价格、玩家间伤害和士兵消息。
recruitment._description_en: Global player hiring management: rank caps, payments, PvP and soldier messages.

max_hired_by_tier._说明_中文: 每位玩家各阶正式雇佣人数上限。
max_hired_by_tier._description_en: Maximum permanent hires per player for each tier.
max_hired_by_tier._说明_roamer_中文: 每位玩家正式雇佣流浪者人数上限，0–10000整数。
max_hired_by_tier._description_roamer_en: Maximum permanent roamer hires per player, integer 0–10000.
max_hired_by_tier._说明_tier1_中文: 每位玩家正式雇佣一阶人数上限，0–10000整数。
max_hired_by_tier._description_tier1_en: Maximum permanent tier1 hires per player, integer 0–10000.
max_hired_by_tier._说明_tier2_中文: 每位玩家正式雇佣二阶人数上限，0–10000整数。
max_hired_by_tier._description_tier2_en: Maximum permanent tier2 hires per player, integer 0–10000.
max_hired_by_tier._说明_tier3_中文: 每位玩家正式雇佣三阶人数上限，0–10000整数。
max_hired_by_tier._description_tier3_en: Maximum permanent tier3 hires per player, integer 0–10000.

payment_by_tier._说明_roamer_中文: 流浪者雇佣支付物品与数量；另消耗1张合同。
payment_by_tier._description_roamer_en: Payment item and count for roamer; one contract is consumed separately.

roamer._说明_item_中文: 完整注册物品ID，如minecraft:emerald或create:brass_ingot；不按NBT区分。无效或未注册ID禁止生存雇佣。
roamer._description_item_en: Full registered item ID, e.g. minecraft:emerald or create:brass_ingot; matching ignores NBT. Invalid/unregistered IDs block survival hiring.
roamer._说明_count_中文: 支付数量，0–1000000整数；0仅消耗合同。跨背包格合计，数量不足不部分扣款；创造模式免费。
roamer._description_count_en: Integer payment count, 0–1000000; zero consumes only the contract. Totals inventory slots with no partial payment; creative is free.

payment_by_tier._说明_tier1_中文: 一阶雇佣支付物品与数量；另消耗1张合同。
payment_by_tier._description_tier1_en: Payment item and count for tier1; one contract is consumed separately.

tier1._说明_item_中文: 完整注册物品ID，如minecraft:emerald或create:brass_ingot；不按NBT区分。无效或未注册ID禁止生存雇佣。
tier1._description_item_en: Full registered item ID, e.g. minecraft:emerald or create:brass_ingot; matching ignores NBT. Invalid/unregistered IDs block survival hiring.

tier1._description_count_en: Integer payment count, 0–1000000; zero consumes only the contract. Totals inventory slots with no partial payment; creative is free.

payment_by_tier._description_tier2_en: Payment item and count for tier2; one contract is consumed separately.

tier2._说明_item_中文: 完整注册物品ID，如minecraft:emerald或create:brass_ingot；不按NBT区分。无效或未注册ID禁止生存雇佣。
tier2._description_item_en: Full registered item ID, e.g. minecraft:emerald or create:brass_ingot; matching ignores NBT. Invalid/unregistered IDs block survival hiring.

tier2._description_count_en: Integer payment count, 0–1000000; zero consumes only the contract. Totals inventory slots with no partial payment; creative is free.

payment_by_tier._description_tier3_en: Payment item and count for tier3; one contract is consumed separately.

tier3._说明_item_中文: 完整注册物品ID，如minecraft:emerald或create:brass_ingot；不按NBT区分。无效或未注册ID禁止生存雇佣。
tier3._description_item_en: Full registered item ID, e.g. minecraft:emerald or create:brass_ingot; matching ignores NBT. Invalid/unregistered IDs block survival hiring.

tier3._description_count_en: Integer payment count, 0–1000000; zero consumes only the contract. Totals inventory slots with no partial payment; creative is free.

recruitment._说明_allow_hired_pvp_damage_中文: 允许雇佣人类伤害其他玩家及其士兵；默认false，主人和同主士兵始终保护。
recruitment._description_allow_hired_pvp_damage_en: Allow hired humans to damage other players and their soldiers; default false. Owner and same-owner soldiers stay protected.

soldier_messages._说明_中文: 按主人共享的自动消息预算；主动下令确认不受限。
soldier_messages._description_en: Automatic message budgets shared per owner; requested command confirmations are not limited.
soldier_messages._说明_chatter_interval_ticks_中文: 普通自动台词最短间隔，tick；20 tick=1秒。
soldier_messages._description_chatter_interval_ticks_en: Minimum automatic chatter interval in ticks; 20 ticks=1 second.
soldier_messages._说明_chatter_max_per_five_minutes_中文: 每位主人五分钟内普通自动台词上限；0关闭普通台词。
soldier_messages._description_chatter_max_per_five_minute: Chatter quota per owner per five minutes; zero disables chatter.
soldier_messages._说明_report_interval_ticks_中文: 重要状态报告最短间隔，tick。
soldier_messages._说明_report_max_per_minute_中文: 每位主人每分钟状态报告批次上限。
soldier_messages._description_report_max_per_minute_en: Status-report batch quota per owner per minute.
soldier_messages._说明_report_details_per_message_中文: 每批报告显示的详情数；其余汇总，同士兵同类报告合并，最多32项待发详情。
soldier_messages._description_report_details_per_message_: Details shown per report batch; remaining entries are summarized. Repeated soldier/category reports coalesce, with at most 32 pending details.

better_combat._说明_soldier_melee_enabled_中文: 士兵Better Combat近战总开关；安装该模组且开启时使用其攻击范围、形状、连击与动画，关闭或未安装回退原有近战。
better_combat._description_soldier_melee_enabled_en: Soldier Better Combat melee master switch; uses its reach, shapes, combos and animation when installed/enabled, otherwise native melee.

ammunition._说明_中文: 全局远程弹药消耗控制。
ammunition._说明_consume_ammunition_中文: 远程攻击消耗弹药总开关，默认true。关闭后弓弩不要求/消耗箭矢，枪械换弹不要求/消耗弹匣；仍执行正常射击与装填。
ammunition._description_consume_ammunition_en: Ranged ammunition master switch, default true. Disabled bows/crossbows need and consume no arrows; firearm reloads need and consume no magazines. Normal firing/loading still applies.

native_gameplay._说明_中文: 结构与原生战斗规则：disabled_structures为逗号分隔的结构名；max_targeting为同时攻击玩家的人类上限；battle_event可选HumanVsHuman/HumanVsPillager/Random/Disabled。
native_gameplay._description_en: Structure and native battle rules: comma-separated disabled_structures, max_targeting concurrent Human attackers per player, and HumanVsHuman/HumanVsPillager/Random/Disabled battle_event.
native_gameplay._说明_disabled_structures_中文: 禁止生成的结构名称字符串；多个名称用逗号分隔，空字符串不禁用。
native_gameplay._description_disabled_structures_en: Disabled structure names separated by commas; empty string disables none.
native_gameplay._说明_max_targeting_中文: 同一玩家可被人类同时锁定的数量上限，0–10000整数。
native_gameplay._description_max_targeting_en: Maximum Humans simultaneously targeting one player, integer 0–10000.
native_gameplay._说明_battle_event_中文: 自然战斗类型：Random随机、Disabled关闭、HumanVsHuman人类对战、HumanVsPillager人类与灾厄村民对战。
native_gameplay._description_battle_event_en: Natural battle type: Random, Disabled, HumanVsHuman or HumanVsPillager.

tacz._说明_中文: 全局枪械联动、生成开关、共享枪械池和目标条件修正。
tacz._description_en: Global firearm integration, spawn switches, shared gun pools and conditional target factors.
tacz._说明_natural_spawn_firearms_enabled_中文: 自然生成与自然战斗额外配枪开关；不影响已有枪、玩家配枪或信号召唤，仍受各阶allow_tacz_firearms限制。
tacz._description_natural_spawn_firearms_enab: Extra guns for natural spawns/battles; excludes existing guns, player input and summons. Rank allow_tacz_firearms also applies.
tacz._description_enabled_en: TaCZ integration master switch; requires TaCZ.
tacz._说明_forced_ranged_gun_chance_中文: 强制远程职业使用枪械的概率，0–1。
tacz._description_forced_ranged_gun_chance_en: Chance of a firearm for forced-ranged roles, 0–1.
tacz._说明_gun_drop_chance_中文: 野生枪械掉落概率，0–1；正式雇佣死亡返还装备不受限。
tacz._description_gun_drop_chance_en: Wild firearm drop probability, 0–1; hired inventory returns are exempt.
tacz._说明_excluded_gun_namespaces_中文: 出生池排除这些枪械ID命名空间；只限制生成。若需同时禁止雇佣装备，请使用gun_blacklist。
tacz._description_excluded_gun_namespaces_en: Exclude these gun ID namespaces from birth pools only. Use gun_blacklist to also ban hired equipment.
tacz._说明_pillager_gun_damage_multiplier_中文: 其他兼容枪手（灾厄村民）的枪伤倍率，0–10；不控制本模组人类。
tacz._description_pillager_gun_damage_multipl: Other compatible gunners (illagers) firearm factor, 0–10; does not control this mod's Humans.
tacz._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 出生枪械ID→非负整数权重。空对象{}按自动收录开关收录合格枪械；非空仅允许正权重条目（全0表示禁用），自动收录不会扩充非空名单。黑名单优先。TaCZ填写枪械ID，焦燃填写物品ID；JSON示例转义用的反斜杠不要写入实际ID。
tacz._description_gun_whitelist_en: Birth gun ID to nonnegative integer weight. Empty {} discovers eligible guns only if automatic discovery is enabled; nonempty is strict (all zero disables). Bans win. TaCZ uses gun IDs; Scguns uses item IDs. Do not include example escape backslashes in IDs.
tacz._说明_auto_add_new_guns_中文: 仅当当前选定白名单为空时，自动收录已加载目录中的合格枪械；非空白名单始终严格限制。
tacz._description_auto_add_new_guns_en: Discover loaded eligible guns only when the selected whitelist is empty. Nonempty pools are always strict.
tacz._说明_auto_added_gun_weight_中文: 空白名单自动收录时，各枪默认相对权重；0表示不生成。
tacz._description_auto_added_gun_weight_en: Default relative weight for empty-pool discovery; zero disables spawning.
tacz._说明_excluded_auto_gun_types_中文: 仅从空名单自动收录中排除这些标准类型；显式白名单可包含它们。标准类型含pistol、smg、rifle、shotgun、sniper、mg、rpg。
tacz._description_excluded_auto_gun_types_en: Types excluded only from automatic discovery; explicit lists may include them. Standard types include pistol, smg, rifle, shotgun, sniper, mg, rpg.
tacz._说明_gun_blacklist_中文: 全局高优先级枪械黑名单：列入的枪不能生成、拾取或交给雇佣士兵装配使用；优先于全局/分阶白名单及自动收录。TaCZ填写枪械ID，焦燃填写物品ID。修改后重启生效，已有库存物品不删除，但不再作为可用枪械。
tacz._description_gun_blacklist_en: Global high-priority gun bans: prevent spawning, pickup, owner equipment input and use. Override global/rank pools and discovery. TaCZ gun IDs / Scguns item IDs. Restart to apply; stored items are retained but cannot be selected.
tacz._说明_shield_damage_multiplier_中文: 人类主动举盾格挡TaCZ子弹时额外承受比例，0–10；默认0.4表示保留40%伤害、减伤60%，仍需真实命中格挡面。
tacz._description_shield_damage_multiplier_en: Additional received fraction for Human active-shield TaCZ blocks, 0–10; default 0.4 retains 40% damage (60% reduction). A genuine frontal block is required.
tacz._说明_offhand_shield_damage_reduction_中文: 主手持枪且副手持可用盾时的全类型伤害减免，0–1；0.2表示减免20%，开枪及换弹均生效，不受主动破盾禁用影响。盾牌在0.1秒（2 tick）内累计承接伤害，按1+floor(累计伤害×1.5)统一经过耐久附魔扣除，不丢弃同窗口弹丸；换盾、保存或打开装备界面前结清。换下枪或盾即失去减伤。
tacz._description_offhand_shield_damage_reduc: All-type damage reduction with a main-hand gun and usable offhand shield, 0–1; 0.2 reduces damage by 20%, including firing/reloading, independently of active shield disable. Wear batches accepted damage for 0.1 seconds (2 ticks): 1+floor(totalDamage*1.5), processed through Unbreaking without discarding pellets. Settle before equipment transfer, saving or inventory editing. Removing either item disables the bonus.
tacz._说明_tamed_maid_damage_multiplier_中文: 人类TaCZ子弹命中已驯服女仆时的额外输出倍率，0–10；与本阶枪伤倍率相乘。
tacz._description_tamed_maid_damage_multiplie: Additional factor for Human TaCZ bullets hitting tamed maids, 0–10; multiplies rank firearm output.
tacz._说明_spawn_pool_source_中文: 出生枪械池来源：global仅用本文件白名单；tier仅用对应阶级文件白名单，不合并或回退。正式雇佣后可使用该后端全部可识别枪械，但全局黑名单始终生效。
tacz._description_spawn_pool_source_en: Birth pool source: global uses only this file; tier uses only the rank file. No merging/fallback. Hired soldiers accept all recognized guns except global bans.

tacz._说明_中文: 本阶TaCZ出生概率、输出倍率和类型权重；兼容总开关及枪械ID名单见global.json。
tacz._description_en: Rank TaCZ spawn chance, damage scaling and type weights; integration switches and gun ID lists are in global.json.
tacz._说明_gun_chance_中文: 本阶额外枪械携带概率，0–1；自然生成还受全局开关和装备成长倍率影响。
tacz._description_gun_chance_en: Rank extra firearm chance, 0–1; natural spawning also uses global switches and equipment growth.
tacz._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 仅控制本阶人类使用TaCZ的枪伤，0–100，默认0.5；Scorched Guns由本阶scguns.damage_multiplier独立控制。目标防护和战斗经验加成另算。
tacz._description_damage_multiplier_en: TaCZ rank damage only, 0–100, default 0.5. Scorched Guns uses rank scguns.damage_multiplier independently. Target defenses and combat experience apply separately.

growth._说明_enabled_中文: 统一成长总开关：装备、出生阶段、经验及战斗成长；关闭时完整属性与装备品质。原版模式开启时优先禁用成长，不改写此项；关闭原版模式后恢复按此项决定是否启用。修改后重启。
growth._description_enabled_en: Unified growth master switch for equipment, birth stages, experience and cultivation. Disabled uses full attributes and gear quality. Vanilla mode overrides growth without changing this preference; leaving vanilla mode restores this setting. Restart to apply.
growth._说明_stage_percent_中文: 阶段0–5的基础生命百分比，6个严格递增整数，范围1–100；默认50/60/70/80/90/100。不控制伤害；伤害由damage_stage_percent独立设置。
growth._description_stage_percent_en: Base health percentages for stages 0–5: six strictly increasing integers in 1–100, default 50/60/70/80/90/100. Damage uses damage_stage_percent separately.
growth._说明_damage_stage_percent_中文: 阶段0–5的近战、弓弩箭及投掷三叉戟伤害百分比，默认75/80/85/90/95/100；6个严格递增整数，范围1–100。分阶伤害先乘此值，再乘战斗经验系数。TaCZ和焦燃枪伤均不使用此阶段削减；枪械经验增伤仍独立生效。
growth._description_damage_stage_percent_en: Melee, bow/crossbow and thrown-trident damage percentages for stages 0–5, default 75/80/85/90/95/100. Six strictly increasing integers in 1–100. Applied after rank damage and before combat experience. Neither TaCZ nor Scorched Guns uses this stage reduction; firearm experience bonuses remain separate.
growth._说明_stage_cost_中文: 阶段0–4升到下一阶段的成长点消耗，5个数字，范围0.001–1000000。
growth._description_stage_cost_en: Growth point cost from stages 0–4 to the next stage: five numbers in 0.001–1000000.

experience._说明_min_percent_中文: 出生经验属性随机下限，1–1000整数百分比，不得大于上限。
experience._description_min_percent_en: Minimum initial experience attribute percentage, integer 1–1000; must not exceed maximum.
experience._说明_max_percent_中文: 出生经验属性随机上限，1–1000整数百分比，不得大于成长上限。
experience._description_max_percent_en: Maximum initial experience attribute percentage, integer 1–1000; must not exceed cap.
experience._说明_cap_percent_中文: 经验属性成长上限，1–1000整数百分比。
experience._说明_below_base_cost_中文: 经验低于100%时，每增加1个百分点所需成长值；正数0.001–1000000。
experience._description_below_base_cost_en: Growth points per next percentage point below 100%; positive 0.001–1000000.
experience._说明_cost_by_band_中文: 五档每增加1个百分点所需成长值，依次对应当前经验100–104%、105–109%、110–114%、115–119%、120%以上；跨档逐点扣费，每项正数0.001–1000000。 修改档宽后按100+i×档宽确定各档起点，超过第五档继续使用最后成本。
experience._description_cost_by_band_en: Five next-point costs for current experience 100–104, 105–109, 110–114, 115–119 and 120 or higher; consume separately across bands; each 0.001–1000000. Band starts are 100+i*band_width_percent; extend the last cost beyond band five.
experience._说明_band_width_percent_中文: 每个经验培养大档的百分点宽度，1–100整数；默认5，对应100/105/110/115/120起始的五档。枪械散布也使用相同档宽。
experience._description_band_width_percent_en: Percentage-point width per experience band, integer 1–100; default 5 gives bands starting at 100/105/110/115/120. Firearm spread uses the same width.

firearms._说明_spread_reduction_per_band_percent_中文: 100%经验为基础散布，每高一个经验档（默认5个百分点）减少此百分比的基础散布；低于100%反向增加，按完整档宽分档；0–100。仅改变人类附加瞄准误差，不改变枪包自带散布。
firearms._description_spread_reduction_per_band_p: Baseline at 100% experience; subtract this percentage of NPC spread per complete experience band (default five points) (inverse below 100%); 0–100. Does not alter gun-pack inherent spread.
firearms._说明_minimum_spread_percent_中文: 经验收缩后的最低附加散布，基础散布的百分比，0–100；默认75%。
firearms._description_minimum_spread_percent_en: Minimum NPC spread as a percentage of baseline, 0–100; default 75%.
firearms._说明_maximum_damage_bonus_percent_中文: 经验从100%到配置的培养上限时，枪伤额外加成从0线性增加到此百分比；低于100%不减伤，上限不高于100%时无加成；0–1000。成长关闭或原版模式时不生效。
firearms._description_maximum_damage_bonus_percen: Linear extra gun damage from zero at 100% experience to this percentage at configured cap; no penalty below 100%, no bonus if cap <=100; 0–1000. Disabled with growth or in vanilla mode.

combat._说明_damage_unit_中文: 每份奖励所需有效伤害点数，0.001–1000000；2点生命=1颗心。
combat._description_damage_unit_en: Effective damage points per reward unit, 0.001–1000000; 2 health points = 1 heart.
combat._说明_reward_unit_中文: 每伤害单位奖励的成长点，0–1000000。
combat._说明_base_cap_中文: 每名士兵对每个确认死亡目标的基础成长点上限，0–1000000。
combat._description_base_cap_en: Base growth point cap per soldier and confirmed dead target, 0–1000000.
combat._说明_bonus_threshold_中文: 额外奖励有效伤害门槛，0–1000000伤害点；必须严格大于，等于不奖励。
combat._description_bonus_threshold_en: Bonus effective damage threshold in damage points, 0–1000000; strictly greater only, equality grants no bonus.
combat._说明_bonus_中文: 超过门槛的额外成长点，0–1000000。

jump_attack._说明_中文: 追击近战跳砍。只控制主动拉近距离的跳砍，不控制普通追击/逃跑跳跃；服务器重启生效。
jump_attack._description_en: Pursuit melee jump attacks only; ordinary chase/retreat hops remain independent. Restart server to apply.
jump_attack._说明_enabled_中文: 允许追击跳砍；关闭不禁止普通移动跳跃。
jump_attack._description_enabled_en: Enable pursuit jump attacks; ordinary movement jumps remain available.
jump_attack._说明_damage_multiplier_中文: 真实跳砍命中的基础近战属性倍率，0–10；上升/下降均生效，原版模式不增伤。
jump_attack._description_damage_multiplier_en: Base melee attribute multiplier at actual jump impact, 0–10; rising/falling hits qualify; vanilla mode disables bonus.
jump_attack._说明_chance_中文: 满足距离、前摇和安全条件后尝试起跳的概率，0–1。
jump_attack._description_chance_en: Chance per eligible attempt after distance, upswing and terrain checks, 0–1.
jump_attack._说明_attempt_interval_min_ticks_中文: 有效跳砍尝试最短间隔，1–1200 tick（20 tick=1秒）；小数向下取整，最小最大颠倒时交换。
jump_attack._description_attempt_interval_min_ticks_: Minimum eligible attempt interval, 1–1200 ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); decimals truncate; reversed bounds swap.
jump_attack._说明_attempt_interval_max_ticks_中文: 有效跳砍尝试最长间隔，1–1200 tick；与最短间隔一起随机抽取。
jump_attack._description_attempt_interval_max_ticks_: Maximum eligible attempt interval, 1–1200 ticks; sampled inclusively with the minimum.
jump_attack._说明_max_approach_distance_extra_中文: 起跳距离超出武器近战触及距离的最大预算，0–4格；实际仍受前摇、相对速度和落点安全限制。
jump_attack._description_max_approach_distance_extra: Maximum approach budget beyond weapon melee reach, 0–4 blocks; upswing, relative speed and terrain safety still apply.
jump_attack._说明_max_target_height_difference_中文: 允许起跳的目标与自身最大高度差，0–2格；不是允许坠落高度。
jump_attack._description_max_target_height_differenc: Maximum target height difference for initiation, 0–2 blocks; not a permitted fall height.

first_aid._说明_中文: 仅调整本模组人类使用First Aid用品；玩家机制保持原模组规则。敷用时间和恢复节奏沿用First Aid公开API。已消费用品的疗程不会因关闭开关而作废。
first_aid._description_en: NPC-only First Aid effects. Players retain native behavior; application/healing cadence uses the public API. Already paid courses continue if disabled.
first_aid._说明_enabled_中文: 启用First Aid用品识别、拾取品质和主动使用；未安装First Aid时无作用。
first_aid._description_enabled_en: Enable First Aid supply recognition, pickup quality and AI use; requires First Aid.
first_aid._说明_plaster_healing_中文: 敷料完整疗程总恢复量，0–2048生命点；0禁止主动使用此药。两种恢复用品共用疗程冷却。
first_aid._description_plaster_healing_en: Total plaster course healing, 0–2048 health; zero prevents AI use. Both medicines share the full course cooldown.
first_aid._说明_bandage_healing_中文: 绷带完整疗程总恢复量，0–2048生命点；0禁止主动使用此药。
first_aid._description_bandage_healing_en: Total bandage course healing, 0–2048 health; zero prevents AI use.
first_aid._说明_morphine_duration_seconds_中文: 吗啡抗性与使用冷却持续时间，1–3600秒；小数向下取整。抗性生效期间不重复使用。
first_aid._description_morphine_duration_seconds_e: Morphine resistance and cooldown duration, 1–3600 seconds; decimals truncate; no reuse during resistance.
first_aid._说明_morphine_resistance_level_中文: 吗啡抗性提升等级，1–5（1代表抗性I）；小数向下取整。
first_aid._description_morphine_resistance_level_e: Morphine resistance level, 1–5 (1 = Resistance I); decimals truncate.

quality._说明_中文: 单件用品拾取品质，0–1000；堆叠数量由背包策略另行计算，品质不决定治疗强度。
quality._description_en: Per-item pickup quality, 0–1000; stack count is evaluated separately; quality does not change healing.

scguns._说明_中文: Scorched Guns可选联动；仅调用原生枪械/投掷物/袭击API，移动与战术由本模组管理。修改后重启生效。
scguns._说明_ai_accuracy_modifier_中文: AI瞄准精度系数越大越准：原生AI误差锥角=min(25度,5×难度系数÷此值)。武器及配件本身的散布另由原模组数据控制；经验收缩只作用于AI误差，不重复叠加各阶TaCZ角度散布。
scguns._description_ai_accuracy_modifier_en: Higher means more accurate: native NPC error is min(25 degrees, 5 * difficulty factor / accuracy). Native weapon/attachment spread remains separate. Experience affects AI error only.
scguns._说明_human_gun_damage_multiplier_中文: 本模组人类使用焦燃枪械的全局伤害倍率，默认0.7表示同等枪械条件下保留玩家基准的70%伤害。替代焦燃NPC难度系数和mobGunDamageMultiplier，并取消该类子弹命中玩家时的原版难度缩放；继续叠乘各阶scguns.damage_multiplier及战斗经验枪伤加成。保留焦燃对所有枪械生效的globalDamageMultiplier、武器/附魔、护甲和抗性。0为无枪伤，1为不减伤；不修改玩家和焦燃原生生物。
scguns._description_human_gun_damage_multiplier: Human-only Scorched Guns damage factor: 0.7 retains 70% of the equivalent player weapon baseline, 1 applies no reduction. Replaces native NPC difficulty/mob damage scaling and vanilla player-target difficulty scaling. Rank damage and training remain multiplicative; universal gun config, armor and effects remain intact. Player shooters and native mobs are unchanged.
scguns._说明_magazines_per_reload_by_type_中文: 每次装满或补满能量按原生武器类型一次计费；普通枪与能量枪相同，战斗中不足一次射击才装填；全局关闭弹药消耗时不扣弹匣。 能量枪通过Forge能量能力读取、扣除和充满能量；不足一次射击时按原生换弹时长补能，同样消耗通用弹匣。不给没有充放电能力的枪写假能量。
scguns._description_magazines_per_reload_by_typ: One payment per native weapon-type reload, including energy recharge through Forge energy capabilities. Native reload duration applies; ammunition master switch can waive magazine consumption.

scguns:basic_poultice._说明_中文: 仅作用于本模组人类；治疗为生命点，20 ticks=1秒，效果等级从1开始。四种药共用冷却；shared_cooldown_ticks是无再生时的基础冷却，有再生则自动使用配置的再生持续时间（多条取最长），伤害吸收不延长冷却或阻止再次使用。

scguns:honey_sulfur_poultice._说明_中文: 仅作用于本模组人类；治疗为生命点，20 ticks=1秒，效果等级从1开始。四种药共用冷却；shared_cooldown_ticks是无再生时的基础冷却，有再生则自动使用配置的再生持续时间（多条取最长），伤害吸收不延长冷却或阻止再次使用。

scguns:dragon_salve._说明_中文: 仅作用于本模组人类；治疗为生命点，20 ticks=1秒，效果等级从1开始。四种药共用冷却；shared_cooldown_ticks是无再生时的基础冷却，有再生则自动使用配置的再生持续时间（多条取最长），伤害吸收不延长冷却或阻止再次使用。

throwables._说明_中文: 消耗背包真实投掷物；除震撼弹外9种焦燃徒手道具可使用。出生池为手榴弹、钉子炸弹、毒气手雷、窒息弹、虫群炸弹，各权重3，与战术药水共用总数。预测使用原生工厂对应的重力和引爆/反弹方式；出手点在身体前方且不能穿墙。攻击许可、视线、弹道和友军安全检查通过才投掷；毒气/窒息弹至少16格友军安全半径。没有自动制导，投出后友军仍可能进入危险区。
throwables._description_en: Consumes inventory; nine supported native hand-thrown items excluding Stun Grenade. Spawn pool: Grenade, Nail Bomb, Gas Grenade, Choke Bomb, Swarm Bomb, weight 3 each, sharing tactical counts. Predict native constructor gravity, bounce and effect timing. Launch outside the owner without crossing walls. Preserve attack permission, line of sight, trajectory and friendly safety (gas/choke at least 16 blocks). No homing or guarantee against allies moving into hazards.
throwables._说明_maximum_range_中文: 最大主动投掷距离，单位格；默认32，范围1～64且不小于minimum_range。距离许可不代表一定能越过障碍或抵达安全落点。
throwables._description_maximum_range_en: Maximum active throw range in blocks, default 32, 1–64 and no less than minimum_range. Range does not override trajectory or safety validation.
throwables._说明_initial_speed_中文: 实际初速度，单位格/tick；默认2.0，范围0.5～3。固定速度求低弧线，使用原生重力/阻力/反弹预测落点；不能安全到达时不投掷。
throwables._description_initial_speed_en: Actual launch speed in blocks/tick, default 2.0, range 0.5–3. Fixed-speed low arc using native gravity/drag/bounce; skip unsafe or unreachable endpoints.
throwables._说明_cooldown_ticks_中文: 普通目标成功投掷后的冷却，单位tick；默认160（8秒），范围1～72000。敌群达到集群人数时取该值与cluster_cooldown_ticks的较小值。
throwables._description_cooldown_ticks_en: Cooldown after successful ordinary throws, default 160 ticks (8 seconds), range 1–72000. Cluster throws use the smaller of this value and cluster_cooldown_ticks.
throwables._说明_cluster_radius_中文: 敌群集中半径，单位格；默认4，范围1～12。以当前合法仇恨目标附近最多16名合法、可见敌人为候选，选择半径内敌人较多的实际敌人位置，不取可能位于悬崖或墙内的平均点。
throwables._description_cluster_radius_en: Cluster radius in blocks, default 4, range 1–12. Up to 16 local permitted visible enemies; aim at an actual enemy with dense neighbors, not an unsafe centroid.
throwables._说明_cluster_minimum_targets_中文: 启用集群优先投掷的最少敌人数，包含中心目标；默认3，范围2～16。只改变战术投掷落点，不改变主战斗目标。
throwables._description_cluster_minimum_targets_en: Minimum enemies including the center for clustered throws, default 3, range 2–16. Does not switch the main combat target.
throwables._说明_cluster_cooldown_ticks_中文: 成功向达到集群条件的目标投掷后冷却，单位tick；默认80（4秒），实际取它与普通cooldown_ticks的较小值。安全条件不放宽；普通失败预检仍间隔40tick。
throwables._description_cluster_cooldown_ticks_en: Cooldown after a successful clustered throw, default 80 ticks (4 seconds), capped by ordinary cooldown_ticks. Safety remains mandatory; failed preflight remains throttled to 40 ticks.
throwables._说明_quality_中文: 投掷物的背包品质评分，默认170，范围0～1000；统一影响拾取、满背包替换及保留判断，不是伤害或生成抽取权重。高于一般战术药水和非职业优先弹药，低于职业优先弹药180；仍遵守食物槽位、最后恢复药品及必要武器保护。
throwables._description_quality_en: Inventory value for supported throwables, default 170, range 0–1000. Used for pickup/replacement/retention, not damage or spawn weight. Above ordinary tactical potions and secondary ammo, below profession-preferred ammo (180). Food, last medicine and essential weapon reservations remain intact.

signal_flare._说明_中文: 新增本模组信号弹由玩家使用，触发Scorched Guns原生袭击；raid_id必须对应已加载的原生raid与flare数据。和平难度、无效维度、已有袭击时不消耗物品。

scguns._说明_spawn_pool_source_中文: 出生枪械池来源：global仅用本文件白名单；tier仅用对应阶级文件白名单，不合并或回退。正式雇佣后可使用该后端全部可识别枪械，但全局黑名单始终生效。
scguns._description_spawn_pool_source_en: Birth pool source: global uses only this file; tier uses only the rank file. No merging/fallback. Hired soldiers accept all recognized guns except global bans.
scguns._说明_gun_whitelist_中文: 出生枪械ID→非负整数权重。空对象{}按自动收录开关收录合格枪械；非空仅允许正权重条目（全0表示禁用），自动收录不会扩充非空名单。黑名单优先。TaCZ填写枪械ID，焦燃填写物品ID；JSON示例转义用的反斜杠不要写入实际ID。
scguns._description_gun_whitelist_en: Birth gun ID to nonnegative integer weight. Empty {} discovers eligible guns only if automatic discovery is enabled; nonempty is strict (all zero disables). Bans win. TaCZ uses gun IDs; Scguns uses item IDs. Do not include example escape backslashes in IDs.
scguns._说明_gun_blacklist_中文: 全局高优先级枪械黑名单：列入的枪不能生成、拾取或交给雇佣士兵装配使用；优先于全局/分阶白名单及自动收录。TaCZ填写枪械ID，焦燃填写物品ID。修改后重启生效，已有库存物品不删除，但不再作为可用枪械。
scguns._description_gun_blacklist_en: Global high-priority gun bans: prevent spawning, pickup, owner equipment input and use. Override global/rank pools and discovery. TaCZ gun IDs / Scguns item IDs. Restart to apply; stored items are retained but cannot be selected.
scguns._说明_auto_add_new_guns_中文: 仅当当前选定白名单为空时，自动收录已加载目录中的合格枪械；非空白名单始终严格限制。
scguns._description_auto_add_new_guns_en: Discover loaded eligible guns only when the selected whitelist is empty. Nonempty pools are always strict.
scguns._说明_auto_added_gun_weight_中文: 空白名单自动收录时，各枪默认相对权重；0表示不生成。
scguns._description_auto_added_gun_weight_en: Default relative weight for empty-pool discovery; zero disables spawning.
scguns._说明_excluded_auto_gun_types_中文: 仅从空名单自动收录中排除这些标准类型；显式白名单可包含它们。标准类型含pistol、smg、rifle、shotgun、sniper、mg、rpg。
scguns._description_excluded_auto_gun_types_en: Types excluded only from automatic discovery; explicit lists may include them. Standard types include pistol, smg, rifle, shotgun, sniper, mg, rpg.
scguns._说明_excluded_gun_namespaces_中文: 出生池排除这些枪械ID命名空间；只限制生成。若需同时禁止雇佣装备，请使用gun_blacklist。
scguns._description_excluded_gun_namespaces_en: Exclude these gun ID namespaces from birth pools only. Use gun_blacklist to also ban hired equipment.

shield_pressure._说明_中文: 高压防御优先于进食、喝药和普通反击。仅统计敌方可用盾抵挡的攻击造成的实际生命损失；达到高额或高频门槛后，中断恢复、归还盾牌，枪手先换备用近战武器。随后实际受伤或成功格挡会延长高压，安静期结束恢复普通战术；持续举盾达到max_guard_ticks则主动尝试破局，试探中新扣血仍达高压门槛时重新防御。不直接触发高伤撤退，不统计环境/友军伤害；没有可用盾、破盾冷却、没有备用近战武器的持枪单位及躲避爆炸时不强制压制恢复。
shield_pressure._description_en: Prioritize shields over recovery under pressure. Count actual health loss from hostile, shield-blockable attacks. Interrupt supplies and restore shields; gunners stow their gun for an owned melee weapon. Damage and successful blocks extend pressure until a quiet interval, with a timed breakout trial. Fresh high-pressure damage can end the trial early. Retreat still uses its normal conditions. No recovery suppression without a usable shield/melee swap, during shield disable, inventory editing or explosion escape.
shield_pressure._说明_max_guard_ticks_中文: 连续高压举盾达到此时间后尝试破局；默认140 tick（7秒），范围40～2400。只累计实际强制举盾时间；压力解除后重计。
shield_pressure._description_max_guard_ticks_en: Try breaking a continuous pressure guard after this duration; default 140 ticks (7 seconds), range 40–2400. Starts on actual forced guarding and resets when pressure ends.
shield_pressure._说明_break_attempt_ticks_中文: 破局观察窗口，默认60 tick（3秒），范围10～400。允许按原条件撤退恢复或反击；仅窗口内的新扣血达到高压门槛才提前重新强制举盾，成功后清除旧压力。
shield_pressure._description_break_attempt_ticks_en: Breakout trial duration; default 60 ticks (3 seconds), range 10–400. Normal retreat, recovery and attacks may run. Fresh trial damage meeting pressure thresholds resumes forced guarding early; a successful trial retires old pressure.
shield_pressure._说明_window_ticks_中文: 伤害统计窗口，默认20 tick（1秒），范围5～100。只记有实际扣血的命中。
shield_pressure._description_window_ticks_en: Actual health-loss sampling window, default 20 ticks (one second), range 5–100.
shield_pressure._说明_damage_ratio_中文: 窗口内至少2次命中，合计损失达到最大生命的此比例就进入高压；0.15表示15%。
shield_pressure._description_damage_ratio_en: At least two damaging hits in the window must remove this fraction of maximum health; 0.15 means 15%.
shield_pressure._说明_frequent_hits_中文: 高频分支所需的实际扣血命中次数；还必须满足frequent_damage_ratio，避免极轻微伤害一直锁盾。
shield_pressure._description_frequent_hits_en: Damaging hit count for the frequency branch; frequent_damage_ratio must also be met to avoid locking shields for trivial chip damage.
shield_pressure._说明_frequent_damage_ratio_中文: 高频分支同时要求的累计掉血比例；0.05表示最大生命的5%。高额/高频任一分支满足即触发。
shield_pressure._description_frequent_damage_ratio_en: Minimum cumulative health-loss fraction for frequent hits; 0.05 means 5%. Either pressure branch may trigger defense.
shield_pressure._说明_quiet_ticks_中文: 触发后，距离最后一次实际扣血或成功格挡达到此tick数才解除；默认20 tick（1秒）。无效攻击不会续期。
shield_pressure._description_quiet_ticks_en: Release after this many ticks without actual health loss or a successful block; default 20 ticks. Invalid hits do not extend pressure.
